idea-plugin.name: MCP Kotlin Script
idea-plugin.description:
Adds support for .mcp.kts — a Kotlin script type that connects to MCP servers and generates typed bindings from their tool schemas.

How it works:
  • Declare an MCP server with @file:McpServer("name", "url")
  • Get typed, autocompleted access to all server tools
Example: 
        @file:McpServer("youtrack", "https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/mcp")

        youtrack.searchIssues(query = "project: KT #Unresolved").issues.forEach { println(it.summary) }
Tool schemas are fetched from the server and the generated bindings are written next to the script under mcp-kts-generated/. Opening or reloading the script re-probes the server and rewrites the bindings; if the server is unreachable the last generated bindings are reused.

Keywords: MCP, Model Context Protocol, Kotlin scripting, kts, AI tools, agent, mcp.kts
